hero.title: Shingle roof replacements and tile roof repair
hero.lead: Get expert roof replacements, repairs, and inspections with Sugar Roofing. Free estimates, $99/mo financing, and fast, reliable service across Greater Houston.

services.title: Gutter Installation
services.text: Protect your home from leaks and water damage with seamless gutter installation and fast gutter repairs. Durable, storm-ready solutions for Houston homes.

services.title: Attic & Roof Ventilation
services.text: Poor airflow can trap heat and moisture in your attic, damaging shingles and raising energy bills.
body: We install and repair ridge vents, soffit vents, and attic ventilation systems to keep your home cooler, healthier, and protected year-round.

services.title: Shingle Roof Replacements
services.text: We repair missing, curled, or storm-damaged shingles quickly and professionally.
body: Our team restores your roof’s strength and appearance with clear guidance and no pressure.

services.title: Tile Roof Repair
services.text: Cracked or slipping tiles? We provide expert tile roof repairs that prevent leaks, protect your home, and keep your roof looking seamless.

services.title: Roof Leak Repairs
services.text: Our roof experts pinpoint the source fast and provide targeted repairs to stop the leak at its root.
body: We offer free inspections to assess the severity, and if larger damage is uncovered, we’ll guide you through repair or full replacement options that keep your home protected long-term.

about.title: About Sugar Roofing
text: Sugar Roofing is a roofing contractor on Cabrera Drive in Sugar Land, working on homes from Sugar Land and Pearland to Baytown, League City and Galveston.
The team handles shingle and tile roofs, leak and storm-damage repairs, gutters and attic ventilation. Every job starts with a free estimate, and $99/mo financing is available.
